data.name: Sharishma
data.gender_notes: Sharishma is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharishma is a Sanskrit name that means peaceful, shining, and radiant. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'shanti' which means peace and 'rishmi' which means shining or radiant. This name is often given to a baby girl born during the night when the moon is shining brightly. The name Sharishma carries the meaning “Peaceful, Shining, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharishma usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful, shining, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharishma is a divine name that represents the peaceful and radiant aspects of the universe. It is believed to bring blessings of prosperity, happiness, and good fortune to the one who bears this name.
data.etymology: Sharishma belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Peaceful, Shining, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharishma total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
